title: A Full Circle Podcast
author: Michael Shanks and David Read
description: Hosted by Michael Shanks (Stargate SG-1's "Dr. Daniel Jackson") and David Read (YouTube's Dial the Gate), A Full Circle features Stargate episode reviews, interviews and all new behind-the-scenes insight into the making of the franchise.
